issuer.name: Transact Payments Malta Limited (Visa Europe licence)

funding.supported_assets_note: Main payment asset + optional fallback asset; all cryptocurrencies and precious metals listed on Bitpanda, plus EUR (Crypto Indices excluded). Converted to EUR at the time of payment.

eligibility.usage_note: Source states 'residence in a euro-area country (where the euro is the primary currency)' without a list; the country list above is the ECB euro-area membership (21 countries, Bulgaria since 2026). Fee tables also show SEK/NOK/DKK columns, but the page does not state that the card is offered in those markets.

kyc.stages_note: A verified Bitpanda account is required to order; customers verified via 'Bankident' cannot order a card. Document list and thresholds not stated. An open 'proof of funds' request disables the card until approved.

fees.conditions: Account opening free; first card free.
Initial shipment free. Additional physical card €10; replacement €5.90 in the fee table (FAQ on lost cards says €9.90 — inconsistent on the page).
€0 FX fee from Bitpanda; Visa mark-up applies on the exchange rate (amount not stated).
2% or €2, whichever is higher; local ATM operators may add their own fees.

rewards.conditions: Flat 1% on purchases paid with cryptocurrency, paid in the same cryptocurrency used for the purchase. No cap stated.

evidence.title: Bitpanda Card — product page, fee table, limits, FAQ
evidence.excerpt: Fee table (EUR column): account opening free, monthly free, initial shipment free, non-EUR FX €0 from Bitpanda + Visa mark-up, ATM min 2% or €2. '1% cashback on all crypto asset spending'. Eligibility FAQ: verified account + residence in a euro-area country.

scope.note: Euro-area residents as stated by the page

evidence.contradiction_note: Page metadata says 'up to 2% cashback' while body and FAQ state a flat 1%; replacement card fee is €5.90 in the table and €9.90 in the lost-card FAQ. Both contradictions confirmed on the second read (2026-10-28). Record uses 1% and leaves the replacement fee unmodelled.

evidence.title: Bitpanda card FAQs (help centre)
evidence.excerpt: All users receive a flat 1% cashback on eligible purchases paid with cryptocurrency, paid in the same cryptocurrency. Excluded: fiat, precious metals, stablecoins. Residence in a euro-area country required; Bankident-verified users not eligible. Debit card on Visa; one physical card, up to three virtual cards.

evidence.title: ECB — the euro area members
evidence.excerpt: 21 euro-area countries; Bulgaria adopted the euro in 2026. Used only to expand 'euro-area country' into ISO codes.

scope.note: Reference list, not a Bitpanda source

changelog.reason: Initial record from official product page and help centre FAQ (single read; second read required before publication).

Second independent read of the product page on 2026-10-28: all recorded figures confirmed (eligibility wording, fee table, limits, 1% cashback and exclusions, issuer). Two page-internal contradictions persist and are shown on the card page.

editorial.summary: Visa debit card for euro-area residents with a verified Bitpanda account; no monthly or issuance fee, 1% cashback paid in the crypto you spend (fiat, metals and stablecoin payments earn nothing).
good_for: Euro-area residents who already hold crypto on Bitpanda
Earning cashback in the asset you spend rather than a platform token
not_for: Residents outside the euro area (not stated as available)
People who mainly spend stablecoins or EUR (no cashback)
watch_outs: Conversion spread when a crypto asset is sold to EUR at payment is not stated; the net value shown is partial.
Page says 'up to 2%' in its metadata but documents only a flat 1%.
Spending crypto is usually a taxable event; the provider gives no tax advice and neither do we.
